rationale: The role is focused on building and running AI-powered agents and applications end-to-end (architecture, containerization, CI/CD, monitoring, and production incident fixes) while integrating governed employee data across systems. It also emphasizes engineering multi-model LLM services with reliability controls and maintaining the full lifecycle in production, which maps best to ML production plus agentic system work and supporting data/integration infrastructure.

The role involves building LLM-powered evidence extraction workflows to convert unstructured document data into structured outputs, alongside building and evaluating machine learning models for classification and automation. It also explicitly requires taking best-performing approaches into production with model lifecycle tooling for training orchestration, experimentation, and monitoring (e.g., Kubeflow/Airflow/MLflow), indicating a production-focused ML workflow.

The role requires developing advanced Generative AI/Deep Learning models and using Reinforcement Learning to improve algorithmic trading performance. It also explicitly calls for designing and maintaining reproducible ML pipelines for production and familiarity with MLOps for deployment/monitoring.

The role centers on building end-to-end telemetry/observability and benchmarking infrastructure to monitor inference performance before and after deployment, plus integrating testing methodologies—core MLops responsibilities. It also emphasizes analyzing performance data and delivering actionable insights, aligning with analytics-storytelling and requiring data/automation pipelines.

The role emphasizes Agentic AI/AI Agents, tool-use workflows, and orchestrating LLM-enabled services, indicating primary focus on autonomous agent systems and orchestration layers. It also explicitly includes training/fine-tuning and deploying models with monitoring in cloud environments, which aligns with deep-learning and ML production responsibilities.

The role focuses on developing transformer-based NLP/LLM solutions and building agentic frameworks/workflows using open-source and commercial LLMs, which centers on neural network engineering. It also mentions working with MLOps engineering and cross-functional delivery of ML-driven features, indicating an applied production-oriented ML workflow.

The role focuses on advanced analytics for demand forecasting, pricing/elasticity, and optimization/scenario modeling, along with producing clear visualizations and translating insights into actionable recommendations for commercial, sales, and operations stakeholders. It emphasizes statistical and machine-learning modeling on large datasets, with strong SQL/Python and visualization (Power BI/Tableau) as key deliverables.

The role emphasizes building live-code demos for GenAI/LLM-based systems, creating annotated datasets, and evaluating multilingual model outputs, which aligns most strongly with neural network/LLM engineering. It also includes product analytics and usage analysis in Pendo/Databricks, supporting insights generation and data infrastructure work.

The role focuses on developing and validating LLM models, including knowledge of NLP/LLMs, fine-tuning, and deployment, along with hands-on neural-network tooling (Python, PyTorch/TensorFlow, Hugging Face). It also explicitly requires LangChain and RAG experience for building/evaluating generative AI offerings, including testing and benchmarking.

The role focuses on designing, building, and iterating ML models for eBay search ranking, recommendation, and advertising, indicating deep-learning engineering alongside large-scale neural model work. It also emphasizes production-ready solutions powered by ML and data pipelines (data-engineering) and online experimentation that supports real systems (mlops-production).

The role emphasizes building and shipping agentic, AI-powered solutions and using agent frameworks alongside LLMs for supply chain/operations. It also explicitly includes implementing RAG and fine-tuning as well as internal tools/dashboards to drive measurable impact.

The role centers on developing an agentic GenAI system with LLM orchestration and image generation, plus building production-grade agent evaluations. It also explicitly requires MLOps and platform contributions using MLFlow, Prefect, Databricks, Kubernetes, monitoring, drift detection, and CI/CD for deploying and maintaining ML systems.

The role focuses on designing, prototyping, and evaluating deep learning models across vision/language/audio/video and translating generative AI/foundation model research into prototypes, which aligns with deep-learning and research. It also explicitly includes end-to-end workflows including training, optimization, and deployment on device or cloud with MLOps tooling, matching mlops-production.

The role emphasizes developing and coordinating applications for analytical data mining and business reporting, including Python/SQL/Oracle procedures, BI report tools, and requirements gathering for functional reporting systems. It also includes investigation/resolution of application problems and second-level support, aligning most closely with data engineering and analytics/BI delivery (with only general reference to analytical mining rather than explicit ML training).

The role emphasizes translating complex data into insights and recommendations, defining success metrics, and communicating trade-offs to enable data-driven decisions. It also includes production-quality ML code with monitoring and ongoing improvements to measurement/impact, plus maintaining/improving data science tools and platforms—indicating analytics execution alongside productionization and supporting data/ML workflows.

The posting emphasizes building and maintaining data pipelines and integrations, along with data validation/cleansing and modern cloud-based data engineering practices (e.g., SQL/Python, Airflow/dbt). It also includes creating dashboards/BI reports and presenting insights, indicating a secondary analytics-storytelling component, but the primary focus is data engineering.

The role centers on analyzing transaction/merchant data, building merchant registry/profiling, performing feature engineering/entity resolution, and prototyping machine learning/analytical solutions with evaluation and benchmarking. It also emphasizes scalable Spark/Databricks workflows and ongoing model monitoring/iterative improvement, aligning with both data engineering and production-oriented ML practices.

The role emphasizes building and scaling ML systems with PyTorch plus significant MLOps & deployment work (CI/CD, MLflow/Kubeflow/SageMaker, Docker/Kubernetes). It also includes a substantial portion of data engineering/pipeline development using Python data tools and SQL/NoSQL.

The role emphasizes building LLM-enabled systems with retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector search/vector databases, prompt engineering, and LLM evaluation/guardrails. It also spans deployment and monitoring through the end-to-end ML lifecycle, indicating productionization alongside deep-learning/LLM development.

The role emphasizes building cutting-edge technology using advances in deep learning and machine learning for personalization and recommendation across product surfaces (retrieval, ranking, recommender systems). It also calls for end-to-end experience with large-scale data processing pipelines (Hadoop/Spark) and stream data systems, indicating a strong data-engineering component alongside model development.

The role is centered on validating LLM-based applications and agentic AI systems by identifying conceptual and empirical risks, covering fairness, privacy, explainability, uncertainty quantification, and implementation controls—core responsible-AI work. It also includes reading research papers and building reusable validation models/tools, supporting the research tag.

The role emphasizes developing and evaluating deep learning/NLP models for document understanding (OCR, extraction, classification), which aligns primarily with neural network engineering. It also includes deploying document understanding solutions into production with reliable pipelines, indicating ML operations involvement.

The role involves content classification using a range of approaches from classical Scikit-learn/NLP models to custom neural networks in PyTorch, plus generative model and LLM usage. It also emphasizes processing massive data with Python/SQL/Spark and building ML pipelines on distributed frameworks, indicating a strong data/ML engineering component.

The role focuses on building and operating end-to-end ETL/ELT pipelines, batch and near-real-time workflows, and integrating cloud sources (e.g., Azure Blob/ADLS) with orchestration tools like Airflow and dbt. It also includes production reliability concerns plus CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, and containerized deployments (Docker/Kubernetes), aligning with both data engineering and ML/production operational practices.

The role emphasizes developing and deploying predictive and generative AI models, with production-ready ML pipelines, deployment/monitoring, and lifecycle management. It also requires evaluation, A/B testing, monitoring for fairness/stability, and translating results into actionable stakeholder insights.

The role focuses on quantitative user behavior research, defining and monitoring KPIs, designing causal experiments/A-B tests, and communicating results to product teams—core analytics/decision-support work. It also requires strong SQL and data table design/maintenance, indicating substantial data handling alongside analytics.

The role explicitly requires designing, building, and deploying AI agents and multi-agent workflows, plus contributing to an LLM and agentic AI strategy. It also includes hands-on LLM/RAG work (embeddings, vector search, LLM evaluation) alongside predictive modeling and deep learning for business use cases.
